description: This file defines the class ImmutableMetadataBuilder, a builder for ImmutableMetadata objects, providing methods to set, remove, and build JSON-based metadata with a fluent API.

classes.name: ImmutableMetadataBuilder
classes.description: A mutable builder class for creating ImmutableMetadata objects with a fluent API, supporting JSON field operations.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Creates a new empty ImmutableMetadataBuilder instance.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new ImmutableMetadataBuilder initialized with values from a given JsonObject.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair in the metadata with a predicate filter.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a key or field definition from the metadata.

methods.name: setAll
methods.description: Sets multiple JsonFields into the metadata with a predicate filter.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns an ImmutableMetadata object from the current state.
